steady_sight.configuration.title: Steady Sight
steady_sight.configuration.strength.tool: Dims the edges of the screen at all times, giving your eyes a steady frame to rest on. Meant for players who get motion sick. Standard is a good starting point for most people.
steady_sight.configuration.optimizeVanil: Turns off view bobbing, FOV effects, screen distortion, damage tilt, and auto-jump, and raises the field of view to 80 if yours is currently lower, the first time you load this mod — the built-in Minecraft settings most associated with comfort. Applied once only; your own changes afterward are never overwritten.
steady_sight.configuration.smoothStepCam: Smooths the vertical camera jolt when you step up a block (stairs, slabs, and other one-block ledges) or ride a minecart over an ascending or descending rail, instead of letting it snap. Only the camera is affected — your position, physics, and collision are untouched.
steady_sight.configuration.optimizeOther: Nudges specific comfort-related settings in a few other installed mods (Blueprint's screen-shake scale and shaker cap, Punchy's freeze-shake, SmoothGUI's animation scale) toward less camera motion, the first time this mod loads — only if that mod is installed, and only settings that move the camera itself, never mods that just add visual detail. Applied once only; your own changes afterward are never overwritten. Turn this off if you'd rather this mod only touch its own settings and Minecraft's vanilla ones.
